BrochureContent.Content:
Campbells are delighted to present this property to the open market.

Located in Lettermacaward along the N56, this would make an ideal family or holiday home.

Accommodation consists of a Fully Fitted Kitchen, Living Room with an Open Fire, Bathroom, and Three Bedrooms.

The property is situated as you enter the small village of Lettermacaward and is close to the local Shop and School. 
It is just a short drive to Dungloe Town and is close to local beaches such as Dooey and Narin.

This property qualifies for the Vacant Home Grant.

Viewing is highly recommended is by STRICT appointment with Campbells.ie
